item.subject: science
item.stem:
The diagram shows a bar magnet that Rupa snaps into two pieces. Each piece is labelled.

What should she expect about magnetic poles?

options.A: Each piece still has both a north end and a south end.
options.B: One piece is a lone north pole with no south end.
options.C: Only the painted red end remains a pole after the snap.
options.D: The two poles stay apart as separate single-pole pieces.
